title: RDP panel does not redraw when the vertical splitter is dragged (shows stale frame)
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Summary

Dragging the vertical splitter between the connections tree / property grid and the RDP connection panel does not resize the RDP surface live — the panel shows a stale frame (visually, whatever was behind or underneath the previous frame) instead of the redrawn desktop, until some other event forces a repaint.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open an RDP connection so its tab is active and docked normally (splitter between the side panels and the connection panel).

**We built a UI test around your theory and it does not hold.** The test opens an RDP session against a real server, drags the vertical DockPanel splitter both ways, and reads the application's own verbose log for the resize calls each drag produces. The result:

notes: Instrumented: reporter's premise disproven — ConnectionTab.Resize reaches RdpProtocol8.Resize on every splitter drag with correct sizes (600/760/840/760). Stale frame is downstream (shrink repaint), not a missing trigger. Not reproduced: xrdp never raises OnLoginComplete, Windows target drops session (ext=5). Asked reporter for capture + Resolution/sizing setting. Harness: RdpSplitterRedrawAcceptanceTests.
